payload.title: A reader opens the site's own domain and reads its published articles
payload.description:
The apex thehallucinator.ai serves the Papyrus reader from the Amplify app (one app: reader at the root, console at /newsroom). The labelled placeholder stack releases the apex and www first.

```gherkin
Feature: The site domain serves the real reader

  Scenario: The placeholder releases the hosts before the reader takes them
    Given the humorus-placeholder stack serves the apex and www from its own distribution
    When the Infrastructure workflow runs the retired-placeholder template
    Then its distribution, function and DNS records are removed
    And the apex and www are held by no CloudFront distribution

  Scenario: A reader opens a published article on the apex
    Given a published article of the site
    When a reader opens its address on the apex domain
    Then the headline, the dek and the satire label are in the HTML

  Scenario: A missing address is a real 404
    Given the apex serves the reader
    When a reader opens an address that does not exist
    Then the answer is HTTP 404

  Scenario: The home page lists the published articles
    Given a published article and no dated editions
    When a reader opens the home page
    Then the article is listed
```
